items.title: Explosions rock Damascus near hotel hosting French President Macron
items.description: French officials say Mr Macron did not hear the blasts, and his motorcade continued through the streets of the Syrian capital to a meeting with Syrian President Ahmed Al-Sharaa, in the first by a European head of state since 2024.

items.title: Controversial report calling for NSW DPP to be replaced condemned
items.description: The inquiry into children's identity protection was called in October last year, but has focused almost solely on the leaking of the story to media.

items.title: 'Completely unimaginable': Man critically injured in robot vacuum fire
items.description: The family of a Perth man critically injured when a robot vacuum caught fire at his home say their lives have been "turned upside down" by the "horrific" incident.

items.title: 'My role model': Younger brother speaks after death of Melbourne footballer
items.description: The younger brother of footy player and teacher Nathan Fitzgerald, who died last night, has described him as a "gentle, wonderful" soul who cherished his family.

items.title: Officer filmed punching man was using 'approved manoeuvre', police say
items.description: NSW Police say an officer filmed repeatedly punching a man in the back of the head on in Western Sydney on Monday night was using an "approved manoeuvre".

items.title: Accused double killer Beau Lamarre-Condon's mother granted bail
items.description: Coleen Lamarre has been in custody since April, when she was arrested in Sydney's inner west accused of attempting to influence a key witness in her son's upcoming double murder trial.

items.title: Qantas customers warned not to delete email about $105m settlement
items.description: More than 1 million Qantas customers are being notified they may be eligible for access to a multi-million-dollar settlement.

items.title: A frame-by-frame look at Balogun's infamous red card tackle
items.description: While many agree the red card call was too harsh, the story has become a bigger discussion about FIFA's integrity.

items.title: With just one warhead, China sends a reminder of growing military capacity
items.description: This latest military test demonstrates China's growing willingness to use its military strength to send a warning to the Pacific: that Beijing now has the military and nuclear means to assert its dominance in the region.

items.title: YouTube doubles down on 'false flag' video about Bondi Beach victim
items.description: YouTube's head of policy tells the Royal Commission on Antisemitism and Social Cohesion a video calling the Bondi Beach terror attack a "false flag" does not breach its hate speech policies.

items.title: President Trump Announces U.S. Military Airstrike in Venezuela
items.description: President Trump states the U.S. military conducted its first known airstrike inside Venezuela targeting a dock where drugs were allegedly loaded onto boats[1][2][4].

items.title: Trump Meets Netanyahu at Mar-a-Lago for Gaza Ceasefire Phase Two Talks
items.description: President Trump met with Israeli Prime Minister Netanyahu to discuss advancing phase two of the Gaza ceasefire, including reconstruction and responses to Iran[1][4].

items.title: Feds Launch Massive Taxpayer Fraud Probe in Minnesota After Viral Video
items.description: Federal agencies including DHS, FBI, and ICE investigate $110 million in suspected fraud at Minnesota child care centers following a viral YouTube video[3].

items.title: Americans Express Widespread Opposition to AI Data Centers
items.description: Public backlash against AI infrastructure data centers grows, with protests and demands for bans influencing Democratic Party strategies for future elections[3].

items.title: Elon Musk's Humanoid Robot Vision: China Poised to Lead Production
items.description: China prioritizes humanoid robots in tech race with U.S., ramping up production while warning of industry bubble and potential bottlenecks[3].

items.title: Trump-Putin Call Amid Ukraine-Russia Tensions Over Peace Plan
items.description: President Trump spoke with Putin amid ongoing Ukraine conflict, with Russia reevaluating peace plan tenets after Ukrainian denials[1].

items.title: Democratic Gubernatorial Candidates in Wisconsin Focus on Inflation and Trump
items.description: Seven Democrats vying for Wisconsin governor blame economic issues on Trump and emphasize affordability ahead of 2026 primary[3].
